subtitle: Cognitive Information and Psychological Research Methods
teachers:

educationalGoal:
Students will learn about (1)~(3) through practice.
(1) How to devise psychological survey
(2) How to implement psychological survey
(3) How to summarize and analyze data
advice:
We will cover the following topics:

Pros and cons of psychological survey methods
How to prepare the questionnaire and what to consider
How to conduct the survey
How to summarize and analyze data
How to take ethical considerations into account

This subject is eligible for the course credit system.

activityGoals.body: Ability to be able to explain a series of procedures in psychological survey methods.

achievementLevels.ideal: To be able to explain the rationale for selecting a survey method among various psychological research methods. In addition, the student will be able to understand and practice a series of procedures in psychological survey methods. The student will be able to discuss and apply the points to be considered when conducting psychological survey in detail.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the rationale for selecting a survey method among various psychological research methods. In addition, the student will be able to understand and practice a series of procedures in psychological survey methods. The student will be able to understand the points to be considered when conducting psychological survey in detail.
